column1: # VHDL: design units (entity, architecture, configuration), package and package body (package), components (interface), subprogram bodies (function, nested ones too), labelled processes (function), enumeration and record types (class), array types and subtypes (type_alias), and constants and signals (variable) declared at package or architecture level.
# Not listed: subprogram prototypes in a package header, ports, generics, variables, locals, unlabelled processes, instantiation labels.
